summary: The script is well under the 6-minute limit (about one minute spoken). The main gains are a clearer up-front ask, plainer numbers for a finance audience, and a few r/l-avoiding swaps that also remove idiomatic phrasing.

suggestions.original: Thank you for making time today.
suggestions.replacement: Thank you for your time today.
suggestions.reason: Plainer phrasing that is easier for international listeners to follow.

suggestions.original: to explain the reasoning behind each line.
suggestions.replacement: to walk through the basis for each budget item.
suggestions.reason: 'Line' can be ambiguous; 'budget item' is clearer for this committee.

suggestions.original: We are requesting a total of one point eight million dollars
suggestions.replacement: We are asking the committee to approve a total of $1.8 million
suggestions.reason: Makes the ask explicit and states the figure in numeric form.

suggestions.original: which is a seven percent increase over this year.
suggestions.replacement: which is a seven percent increase over this year, and I will explain why.
suggestions.reason: Signals the reasoning ahead, softening the increase before the justification.
'About' is plainer and avoids the r and l sounds.

suggestions.original: and the remainder is reserved for training and travel.
suggestions.replacement: and the rest goes to training and travel.
suggestions.reason: Plainer than 'remainder' and avoids the r and l sounds.

suggestions.original: which still saves money per unit.
suggestions.replacement: which still reduces our cost per unit.
suggestions.reason: A concrete measure of savings is more persuasive to a finance committee.

suggestions.original: We expect a payback within eighteen months through
suggestions.replacement: We expect the investment to pay for itself within eighteen months through
suggestions.reason: States the payback more clearly, matching the stated priority.

suggestions.original: I welcome your questions and any adjustments you recommend.
suggestions.replacement: I welcome your questions, and I would value any adjustments you recommend.
suggestions.reason: Warmer and more inviting, while keeping the formal tone.
